items.caption: Modern vector rendering of 言 in Shuowen seal-script style. 言 is the semantic component in traditional 謝.
items.alt: Black seal-style 言 glyph centered on a white field.
items.selection_reason: This identified seal-style form illustrates the semantic component in 謝; it is not a historical specimen of 謝 itself.

limitations.text: The image shows 言, not 謝. No verified image here establishes 謝’s historical glyph form; the recorded small-seal specimen does not settle whether earlier forms existed.
